thread:
toni: Heads-up 1: the API ref page for POST /v1/generate mixes `max_tokens` and `max_new_tokens` across examples & schema. The schema shows `max_new_tokens?: number` but the Python/JS snippets still use `max_tokens`. This is causing confusion in support tickets.

liam: ouch. Which one is the canonical param now?

toni: server code accepts both for backward compat, but we prefer `max_new_tokens` (aligns with model naming). We should standardize docs to `max_new_tokens` and add a short migration note.

min: I can update the schema block and all code snippets. Suggestion: keep a line in the example showing the legacy field mapped, e.g.:

```json
{
  "max_new_tokens": 64
  // legacy: "max_tokens": 64 // still accepted
}
```

liam: prefer not to include commented JSON in fenced blocks (some linters fail). Instead add a one-line inline note after the example: "Note: `max_tokens` is accepted for backward compatibility; prefer `max_new_tokens`."

paul: also found a small bug: the cURL sample omits `Content-Type: application/json` and shows `--data-binary` with single quotes which breaks on Windows docs preview. Please use: `-H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @-`.

toni: good catch. I'll change cURL and the SDK snippets. Min, can you run `./scripts/snippet-lint` and `./scripts/docs-build` locally before opening PR? CI doesn't catch the legacy param in the schema.

min: yes will do. Also I'll grep for `max_tokens` in `docs/api` and `docs/snippets` and update.

paul: add a tiny entry under "Migration notes" on the generate page: two bullets: prefer `max_new_tokens`; legacy `max_tokens` still accepted but will be deprecated in 2 minor releases.

toni: timeline: small PR, target merge today. I'll open as draft and tag reviewers.

dev-docs-bot: Draft PR created by toni: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/958 (WIP)

liam: will review after linting passes. thanks all. :thumbsup:
